All three judges scored the fight 48-47 for Gane, who retained the UFC Heavyweight Championship. It was Gane's first successful title defense and Hokit's first career loss. Alex Pereira said "I thought it was a robbery, I thought Hokit won the fight," and fans booed the Gane vs Hokit decision after an early eye poke in round 1. Amanda Nunes came back after three years and Kayla Harrison made her tap in round 4 at 1:29 with a rear-naked choke, and Harrison now claims the GOAT status in women's MMA. Gane vs Hokit set a heavyweight record with 388 significant strikes. Nunes took her gloves off after the fight but did not announce retirement. Josh Hokit suffered his first loss as a professional, and the UFC 334 bonuses went to four fighters including Harrison with $100,000 for Performance of the Night.
